results.detail: All three set operators inside derived table EXPECTED are plain 'union' (no ALL). UNION removes duplicates over all 7 projected columns (expecteddate, valueamount, fundtypename, fundfinanceid, fundtotalassets, producttypecode, bankname) BEFORE SUM(valueamount) - this collapses identical rows both across branches and within the same branch (e.g. two withdrawals of the same amount, same day, same fund), so the reported sum can be too low.
